title: BACKLINKS: PR-NNN markers beside the codified rules in ORCHESTRATION.md, marker-only
description: CD8's one file edit, and the only edit to a live contract document this epic makes. ORCHESTRATION.md is not NLAH-gated and has been task-edited before, so a codified rule may carry a backlink marker to its registry record - which is what turns the registry from a parallel document into something a reader of the prose can actually reach. The rule TEXT does not change: not one word, not one line break, not one re-wrap. You add markers; the verify task diffs your change to prove it is marker-only. Coverage is defined by the frozen ledger's ORCH-HOME flag, not by taste.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ORCHESTRATION.md. Acquire the lock first: python3 .harness/bin/lock.py acquire ORCHESTRATION.md --holder <you> --task T-386, and release it at the end. No other file. No code, no test, no state.json, no record, and explicitly no claude.md and no gemini.md (CD2: the NLAH files are out of scope and their mutation path is the section 5A loop plus the operator's gate).

MARKER FORM, fixed and greppable: append ' (PR-NNN)' - or ' (PR-NNN, PR-MMM)' where a rule has more than one record - at the END of the existing rule's bold lead-in or table cell. No new sentence, no new paragraph, no new line of prose, no heading edit, no reordering, no re-wrapping. The added and deleted line counts in git diff --numstat must be EQUAL.

COVERAGE IS THE LEDGER'S: every row flagged ORCH-HOME in docs/precedent-research/codification-ledger.md that minted a record in wave 1 or wave 2 gets exactly one marker. State both numbers - the ledger's ORCH-HOME count and your marker count - and they must match. PR-002 (P-025), PR-003 (P-026) and PR-004 (F6) are already-codified norms with ORCHESTRATION.md homes and they get markers too.

THE P-023 PARAGRAPH IS OFF LIMITS - PLANNER RULING UNDER CD3: the terminal-state reopen rule (ORCHESTRATION.md section 2) gets NO marker in this epic, even though PR-001 exists, because a marker beside that paragraph reads as 'codified and settled' while the accepted_mutations gap it depends on is open and owned by T-365. State this exclusion explicitly in your handoff so it is a recorded choice and not an oversight.

DIFF DISCIPLINE, SELF-CHECKED BEFORE HANDOFF: run git diff -U0 -- ORCHESTRATION.md and, for every changed line, confirm the removed and added versions differ ONLY by the appended marker. Paste the check and its complete output, plus git diff --numstat -- ORCHESTRATION.md showing equal added and deleted counts. A single reworded, reflowed or reordered line is a REJECT.

EVERY MARKER RESOLVES AND IS THE RIGHT RECORD: python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py show PR-NNN exit 0 for each marker you place, and the record's ratio must actually be the rule the marker sits beside. A marker pointing at a record about something else is worse than no marker.

NO NEW DOUBLE-HOMING: you may not copy any ratio text into ORCHESTRATION.md. INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md section 1 is the model and states the measured cost - stacking a layer that restates another regressed the harness's own corpus system by 2.3 points. Cite, never restate.
NO CODE TOUCHED, so no py_compile applies to your own work; prove non-modification instead with git status --porcelain .harness/bin/ empty and git status --porcelain .harness/tests/ empty.

TEST FLOOR UNCHANGED: python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p "test_precedent*.py" prints a 'Ran N tests' line with N >= 252 and OK (252 measured live 2026-08-13 by the planner; if N is higher, name T-376 as the landed repair rather than absorbing the delta) - the suite must be unaffected by a documentation edit, and running it proves that.

HAND OFF to verifier (never self-mark done). The note carries: the ORCH-HOME count, the marker count, the marker-by-marker table (rule, section, PR id), the excluded P-023 paragraph with its reason, and the complete diff-check output. LEAK AND STYLE HYGIENE (the board and .harness/tasks/*.json are tracked): no absolute filesystem path, no username and no emoji in any note or artifact you write. Temp-root replays print absolute paths - redact them to a placeholder before pasting. Two prior tasks leaked an operator home path exactly this way.
